newsitem.title: EGYPT: Lucent to add 260,000 phone lines in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Lucent to add 260,000 phone lines in Egypt.

text.p: Telecommunication firm Lucent Technologies signed a memorandum of understanding with the Egyptian government to set up 260,000 telephones lines in the capital, Cairo.
The project, part of a five-year plan to add five million lines throughout the country, is to be executed in the next two years.
U.S. Commerce Secretary Mickey Cantor witnessed the signing of the deal and other agreements with U.S. firms on a wide range of projects.
"These agreements are only some of the $20 billion in projects located in the Middle East that U.S. firms are competing for, with the support of the U.S. government," Kantor said.
Lucent's stock was unchanged at $47.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
